original_title: Entre mémoire et histoire : la problématique des lieux
container: Les Lieux de mémoire, I: La République (1984), pp. XVII–XLII; Portuguese translation: Projeto História 10 (1993), pp. 7–28
note: Journal title substituted for Entre memória e história: a problemática dos lugares, translated by Yara Aun Khoury. Same essay as candidate w-2216 (English translation, Representations 26, 1989, pp. 7–24; DOI identifies that translation), not the whole Les Lieux de mémoire.

original_title: A “outra” América: a América Latina na visão dos intelectuais brasileiros das primeiras décadas republicanas
note: USP doctoral thesis, not a published monograph; book is the nearest permitted kind. Title page dates it 1998; repository records defense/publication in 1999. DOI confirmed by the awarding institution; no candidate works.

original_title: A cidade dos encantados: pajelanças, feitiçarias e religiões afro-brasileiras na Amazônia, 1870–1950
note: Belém: Vicente Salles/EDUFPA, 2008. Published book derived from Figueiredo’s earlier dissertation; no candidate works.

original_title: Usos & abusos da história oral
note: Conflated citation. FGV, 1996/2006 and Amado suggest Janaína Amado and Marieta de Moraes Ferreira’s edited volume (ISBN identifies 1996 edition). Jorge Amado and Mar Morto point instead to the 1936 novel, candidate w-1160729. Cannot safely choose between these works from this fragment.

original_title: Slavery and the Demographic and Economic History of Minas Gerais, Brazil, 1720–1888
note: Escravidão e história econômica: demografia de Minas Gerais, 1720–1888 (EDUSC, 2004) is the Portuguese translation; the journal review explicitly identifies the 1999 original. Author surname is Bergad.

original_title: Merkantilismen: ett led i den ekonomiska politikens historia
note: La época mercantilista (Fondo de Cultura Económica, 1943) is the Spanish translation of the work represented by Mercantilism (1935). Swedish original, Merkantilismen (1931), is not among the candidates.

id: W:hartog|o seculo xix e a historia
original_title: Le XIXe siècle et l'histoire : le cas Fustel de Coulanges
note: Shortened citation of O século XIX e a história: o caso Fustel de Coulanges (Editora UFRJ, 2003), Portuguese translation of the 1988 French book.

original_title: Le Système des objets
note: Portuguese translation by Zulmira Ribeiro Tavares. Catalogue gives the French original title. Prefer the original candidate over The system of objects (w-94710).

id: W:kidder|reminiscencias de viagens e permanencia no brasil
original_title: Sketches of Residence and Travels in Brazil, Embracing Historical and Geographical Notices of the Empire and Its Several Provinces
note: Portuguese title of Kidder’s two-volume 1845 work, translated by Moacir N. Vasconcelos. OCLC confirmed in the catalogue; no candidate author/work supplied. Distinct from Brazil and the Brazilians, coauthored with James C. Fletcher.

original_title: Iconographie de l'art chrétien
note: Spanish multivolume translation, Ediciones del Serbal. Catalogue explicitly supplies the French original title. Original published 1955–1959.

original_title: History of Economic Analysis
note: Portuguese translation published in 1964, in three volumes. Catalogue identifies the English original; distinct from Economic Doctrine and Method.

original_title: Dei delitti e delle pene
note: Portuguese translation of Beccaria’s 1764 treatise. Publisher confirms original title; prefer the 1764 original candidate to later editions and translations.

original_title: O arcaísmo como projeto: mercado atlântico, sociedade agrária e elite mercantil em uma economia colonial tardia, Rio de Janeiro, c.1790–c.1840
note: Cited title is only coauthor FLORENTINO, Manolo. Most likely Fragoso and Florentino’s O arcaísmo como projeto, represented by w-415187; catalogue confirms a fourth, revised and enlarged 2001 edition (OCLC supplied). Missing title prevents a firm assignment.

original_title: Muitas memórias, outras histórias: cultura e o sujeito na história
container: Déa Ribeiro Fenelon, Laura Antunes Maciel, Paulo Roberto de Almeida and Yara Aun Khoury (eds.), Muitas memórias, outras histórias. São Paulo: Olho d’Água, 2004, pp. 116–138.
note: Khoury’s chapter, not the complete edited collection. ISBN identifies its container, confirmed in UFSC Library’s acquisitions catalogue, p. 142. Chapter citation/pages also confirmed by Revista História & Perspectivas author guidelines; no DOI located.

original_title: A experiência do tempo: conceitos e narrativas na formação nacional brasileira (1813–1845)
note: Only imprint survives. Araújo, Hucitec and 2008 strongly suggest A experiência do tempo, candidate w-1174595; no firm match without a title. Publisher confirms author/year/ISBN but transposes subtitle dates to 1831–1845; candidate gives 1813–1845.

original_title: O systema eleitoral no Brazil: como funcciona, como tem funccionado, como deve ser reformado
note: By Francisco Belisário Soares de Souza, not Francisco de Assis Lemos Souza. Reissued as O sistema eleitoral no Império (Senado Federal/UnB, 1979), with legislative appendix. Original confirmed in TSE catalogue, handle bdtse/5993; no LCCN, ISBN or OCLC could be verified, so identifier fields remain blank.

original_title: Le temps de l'histoire
note: Portuguese translation of Ariès’s 1954 book; the cited 1989 edition predates the later Unesp edition shown by the publisher.

original_title: La culture des apparences : une histoire du vêtement (XVIIe–XVIIIe siècle)
note: A cultura das aparências: uma história da indumentária (séculos XVII–XVIII), Senac, 2007. Journal review confirms original Paris 1989 publication and Brazilian translation. Prefer French original to The culture of clothing.

original_title: The Theory of the Leisure Class: An Economic Study in the Evolution of Institutions
note: Portuguese translation of Veblen’s 1899 book; candidate w-195619 represents a 1912 English edition. Not The theory of business enterprise or the short essay The barbarian status of women.

original_title: O anjo da história
note: João Barrento’s Portuguese selection of ten German essays, with commentary and letters; first issued by Assírio & Alvim in 2010, Brazilian edition Autêntica 2012 (ISBN confirmed by publisher). No single German original under this title. Not identical to Über den Begriff der Geschichte alone, Illuminations, or other candidate collections.
